name: App Update Settings
description: Controls the mobile app's force/optional update prompt. Set the latest published versionCode (optional prompt) and the minimum supported versionCode (hard block) when you publish a new build.

fields.label: Latest versionCode
fields.description: The newest published build's versionCode. Installs below this are shown an optional 'Update available' prompt.

fields.label: Minimum supported versionCode
fields.description: Installs BELOW this are hard-blocked with a 'Update required' screen until they update. Set it equal to the latest versionCode to force everyone onto the new build.

fields.label: Update URL
fields.description: Where 'Update now' sends the user — the Play Store listing, or a direct APK link.

fields.label: Update Message
fields.default: A new version of Naarni Service is available. Please update to continue.
